name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=cast, descriptor=ap_boost_spell). Accurately reflects the purpose: the AP (Attack Power) boost spell/item effect worker. 'ap' = Attack Power stat (matches sibling fd2_cast_dp_boost_spell @0x22866 which boosts DP); 'boost_spell' = the buff effect class. No Ghidra address residue; no domain-ID to preserve.
purpose: AP-boost (Attack-Up) spell/item effect: plays the per-target impact + status-overlay-flicker animations (effect id 0x11), then for each target unit applies a one-shot AP buff guarded by a per-target stack-protection timer, drawing the boost amount as a heal-style number and crediting pending XP.
logic_summary: Play fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target(caster,0x11,n,targets) then fd2_animate_status_effect_overlay_flicker(caster,0x11,n,targets). For iter=0..num_targets-1: target_id=target_id_array[iter]; target_rc=&runtime_char_array[target_id]; level_mod=target_rc->status_flags_block[0] (unit level byte), +0x1e (30) when 8<job_id<0x19 (intermediate class). If target_rc->status_flags_block[1] (AP-buff timer) == 0 (not yet boosted): call fd2_advance_rng_state and set timer = (rng_return % 4) + 2 (2..5 turns); delta = (int)(1.0 + ap * 0.15) with Watcom truncate-toward-zero; fd2_show_damage_number(delta, 0x69 'i', target_id); target_rc->ap += (int16)delta; pending_xp_credit += level_mod*2. Else (already boosted): fd2_show_miss_indicator(target_id) (no stacking). After the loop: fd2_composite_battle_frame(0); fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths().
